issue.title: agents_selected_panel_clan_collapse PNG golden fails on clean master: 'home' agent-row label is bold in the golden, regular weight in the render
issue.description:
`tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_panel_clan_collapse.py::test_selected_panel_clan_collapse_precedes_status_group_png_snapshot`
fails `just test-visual` on a clean master tree: the golden
`tests/ace/tui/visual/snapshots/png/agents_selected_panel_clan_collapse_120x40.png` no longer
matches what the app renders.

The difference is one word, not renderer noise. The agent row for the fixture agent named
`home` (a DONE agent with no tribe) is rendered **bold** in the golden but in **regular
weight** by current master. 354 pixels change, with the bounding box confined to that label
(x 181-228, y 167-184 of a 1482x1026 image); every other pixel matches. Side-by-side crop
attached as a ref (top = golden, bottom = actual).

Reproduction (2026-09-20, workspace sase_32, HEAD == origin/master ec7dbbfdf after
`just install`):

1. Full check-only run, `just test-visual`: 973 passed, 1 skipped, then
   `counts: created=0 updated=1 unchanged=709 stale=0`. The single updated record is this
   snapshot.
2. With every local change stashed (clean tree), the targeted run
   `just test-visual -- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_panel_clan_collapse.py`
   reports the same single drift (`updated=1`).

Lead, NOT bisected: the golden was last refreshed by 8c83b8f0e. 7442af7af ("insert arriving
agent rows in place and settle the column in one frame") touches agent-row rendering and
landed after it, so it is the first commit to check. Decide which side is wrong: either the
row-name weight regressed (fix the renderer) or the change was intended (refresh this golden
via `just fix-tui-screenshots` and inspect the report; generation is not approval).

Scope: this node only. Related but not duplicates: sase-x5 (older residual golden drift with
a font/renderer-drift hypothesis and a different, since-shrunk node set) and sase-ce (closed;
refreshed this same golden among six).

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic: the same single 354-pixel drift appeared in a full test-visual run and again in an isolated targeted run on a clean stashed tree, and it is confined to one label whose weight visibly differs (bold in the golden, regular in the render), so it is a content change, not pixel noise.

payload.description: Older residual PNG golden drift on clean master (font/renderer-drift hypothesis, different node set); this node has a distinct identified cause: a label weight change
Closed; refreshed this same golden among six earlier, so the drift is new since that refresh

evidence.note: Independent repro 2026-09-20: the golden drifts on 4 of 4 'fix-tui-screenshots --check' runs (one full 710-golden run and three targeted), including a pristine export of origin/master ec7dbbfdf, so it is independent of sase-11y.10.1.2 (whose 21 Axe goldens were regenerated and are unaffected). I confirmed drift only; I did not inspect the pixel diff.
